suggestions.quote: the Tail End arithmetic on in-person time left with parents
suggestions.fix: This is where I leave. The empty tiffin already landed, then a name I would not understand turns into a lesson. One spoken line while her counter flips and the tiffin sits there: miss the visits and this is how many are left. Do not say Tail End. Do not add a second fact.

suggestions.quote: The metro stranger: four hundred, your commute.
suggestions.fix: Nothing new happens to me; it is only another number. Cut the stranger, or have me change seats and see I will share this metro with them four hundred more times, then the doors open on the colleague.

suggestions.quote: a forecast of the times you will meet them again in person, recalculated whenever your plans change.
suggestions.fix: On a phone with the sound low I lose this. Say: Everyone you know has a counter. It counts the times you will see them in person. You shrug that it only counts down. You can lose forty-two mornings. What would you do with the next one?

keep.quote: forty-two, the times you will see her again
it was never her clock, only your trains
She's still at the door. Of course she is.
